title: Federal Ammunition, Mossberg, and Palladyne AI Launch Joint Development of SwarmShot™, a Modular Autonomous Airborne Counter-UAS System
summary: ANOKA, Minn. & NORTH HAVEN, Conn. & SALT LAKE CITY, October 07, 2026--Federal Ammunition, part of The Kinetic Group, a member of CSG Group (Euronext Amsterdam: CSG); Mossberg; and Palladyne AI Corp. (NASDAQ: PDYN), today announced the joint development of SwarmShot™, a modular autonomous airborne counter-unmanned aircraft system (C-UAS) designed to transform compatible drones into reusable air-to-air interceptors operating together as a collaborative kinetic defensive swarm.
